entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: It's starting to get rather cold, isn't it?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Sorry to bring you here. This is something[n]I oughtn't really bring up around other[n]people.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: [lName]-senpai, are you still planning[n]to continue on as the Phantom Thieves?
What do you mean?
Why do you ask?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: ...Lately, I haven't been hearing any[n]positive gossip about the Phantom[n]Thieves.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Despite how much people cheered[n]on your cause—even though they knew[n]nothing about you or your friends...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: All they do now is speak ill of the[n]Phantom Thieves!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I know it's not my place to say this,[n]considering I turned down your[n]offer to join and all...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: But this change in attitude is simply[n]awful.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: They're doing the exact same thing[n]to you all that they did to me...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Yet you're still going to keep at it?[n]Why, Senpai?
I have to take care of something.
There's unfinished business.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Take care of something...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Mm. I see...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Unfinished business?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: So, there's something left you have to do.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yeah...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But don't worry about us!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There isn't even a one in a million chance[n]that my Phantom Thieves could ever lose!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I see...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Well, I won't stop you.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: However... could I ask a favor? Or rather,[n]could you promise me something?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Once things settle down, I'd like you[n]to join me somewhere so we can go[n]have some fun together.
I promise.
I look forward to it.
I might not be able to...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Then it's a deal!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I am too.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Don't say things like that, even if you're[n]just joking.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I'm already beginning to look forward[n]to it.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: So... Please be careful out there.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Oh, but I plan to keep my other promise[n]I made with you, about the physical[n]training.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Tomorrow—is that too sudden? Maybe[n]we should train the day after tomorrow,[n]then?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Uh, but that day's when...
Maybe another time.
Another day works better.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Mm. I see.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Ah! I haven't eaten yet!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Come on, [lName]-senpai! You need[n]to eat too!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: No one wins a fight on an empty[n]stomach, you know!
